author: jracer15
body:
After it didn't make it to the updated rotations I decided to not give up and make one massive update to Medieval!  It's the first defense friendly walls where you can defend your castle with your team!  This not only brings a new gameplay but should also bring some more team work in walls!  Of course there it is Medieval themed inspired by Medieval times!


2.0 Update
- Added much more terrain to the map!
- The kings room is gone, didn't seem to fit!
-  Instead of the prison under the castle is the dungeon for the prisoners!
- The castle has more of a community feel with villager trade, sheep pen, and crafting post!
- Added another Medieval house!
- Redesigned the water path to feel more real!
- The middle has been changed as a kings throne!
- The ground is has gravel patches for a more Medieval feel!

Pictures!
http://imgur.com/a/IgMYt

Download with YML!
https://www.dropbox.com/s/mcntvmtpm3q1xj6/Medieval%202.0.zip

I hope you like it, leave your thoughts on the map, look at the pics, and download the map!

P.S.Thanks Polar_Express and Spock404 for the help!
